inputs.Z: Smooth integral closed subvariety of X
inputs.E: Coherent rank-one torsion-free sheaf on Z
inputs.optional_T: Declared finite-dimensional space of ambient deformation directions

calculation: delta_Z(kappa) = restriction followed by T_X|Z -> N_Z/X

outputs.if_delta_nonzero: NO_PERFECT_LIFT of i_*E over specified X_R
outputs.kernel_relation: ker complete_AtKS(i_*E) is contained in ker delta_Z
outputs.image_relation: im complete_AtKS|T surjects to im delta_Z|T; injectivity is not asserted

proof_dependencies: Rank-one torsion-free is locally a line bundle off codimension >=2 on smooth integral Z
A perfect derived lift of a sheaf over dual numbers is a flat sheaf
Annihilator of locally cyclic lifted sheaf recovers an actual embedded support deformation
Depth >=2 makes H1 restriction away from singular locus injective
Standard complete Atiyah-Kodaira-Spencer perfect-lift criterion with declared hypotheses

fixed_H0P_application.same_carrier: K=Q(i), lattice Z[i]^6, h=diag(1,1,1,-1,-1,-3), A0=E^3 x E^3, diagonal Z
fixed_H0P_application.chern_character: ch3(j_*E)=[Z], with same nonzero exceptional projection
fixed_H0P_application.strict_extension_examples: L tensor I_C for any line bundle L and subscheme C of dimension <=1, including nonreduced curves

excluded_outputs: converse or positive lifting when delta=0
exact rank six for every member
execution: Proof only; source reading, byte comparison and hashes only. No scientific program or numerical experiment run.
